hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The extinct, but quite well-attested, Kulin languages are missing as such from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. One of the Kulin languages was the Western Victoria language (**hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**), which was not necessarily extinct by 1950 (**hh:hw:Hercus:Victoria:1969**).
